title: Soul Snack #55: Can There Be Multiple Intentions?
excerpt: Create the life you desire by choosing love over fear.
bodyHtml:
Create the life you desire by choosing love over fear. Learn how HERE.


Every action begins with an intention, but can one action carry more than one? In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the essence of intention at the deepest level, showing how all intentions can ultimately be traced back to either love or fear. Through practical examples, he illustrates how the same action – a charitable donation, for instance – can manifest entirely different outcomes depending on the intention behind it.

Gary explains that while one person may act from pure love, another may act from fear-driven motives like seeking approval, recognition, or superiority. The energy of your intention determines the consequences in your life and the kinds of people you attract. Love creates harmony, trust, and connection, while fear creates painful consequences and relationships built on second agendas.

Ultimately, the choice of intention is the most important creative decision you make in the Earth School. Each choice determines not only your experiences but also the community of energy and people that surrounds you.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:02) — Two Fundamental Intentions
    Why every action and word is rooted in either love or fear.
  • (00:51) — Love and Fear Cannot Coexist
    How love and fear are mutually exclusive and why the same action cannot hold both intentions at once.
  • (02:49) — Charity Example
    How the same donation can create different outcomes depending on whether the intention is love or fear.
  • (03:48) — Law of Attraction and Intention
    Why the energy behind your intention draws people and experiences of the same energy to you.
  • (05:15) — Intention as the Creative Force
    How intention shapes karma, brings energy into matter, and determines your experiences in the Earth School. 

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, pause to reflect on the intentions behind your daily actions. Ask yourself: Am I acting from love, or from fear?Notice the energy you bring into even small choices, and observe how it affects not only your experience but also the people and situations that come into your life. Experiment with shifting your actions toward love-based intentions and see what changes.
